digest.component_or_area: Plan review caching and prompt engineering
propositions: Pass-1 finder and Pass-2 verifier prompts must share a byte-identical plan-bearing prefix to enable Anthropic's whole-block cache reuse via single-sourced `shared_plan_prefix()` in prompts.py
The shared prefix must exceed CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS (4096 tokens) to trigger Anthropic's provider-side prefix caching, measured as `est_tokens(shared_plan_prefix(plan))` rather than plan alone

Verifier templates transition from carrying `{{plan}}` in the volatile marker's user-turn segment to leading their system prompt with `{{shared_prefix}}`, making the entire rendered template the stable cached system segment
An exhaustiveness directive bullet added to SHARED_STANCE_PREAMBLE ensures Pass-1 finders enumerate every independent defect in each run without deferring findings to later rounds
Plan-review.yaml verify steps must supply `shared_prefix` from verify_inputs outputs instead of `plan`, and the output schema must drop the `plan` property
Pass-1 warm-gate boundary condition must measure `_prefix_tokens(plan)` to reflect actual bytes sent (shared prefix), not plan-alone tokens, ensuring consistent gate thresholds
